messages:
maria: FYI ticket 8921 from Acme — their API started returning 5xxs after an automatic failover this morning. customer reports 'tokenizer mismatch' + big latency spikes.
ken: Which region were they pinned to?
maria: They were pinned to us-west-2 but our routing logs show requests routed -> eu-west-1 fallback at 07:12 UTC.
tom: We had capacity pressure in us-west and smart-routing allowed region fallback. That should NOT happen for pinned customers. Investigating policy.
infra-bot: route-eval: request_id=abc123-route -> routed to eu-west-1 due to capacity_threshold breach (us-west-2 pool at 98%).
nina: Customer sent a sample payload and error is "TokenizerMismatch: unknown special token <SYS>" in response body.
maria: They were served legacy-1.0-quant variant on eu-west which uses a different vocab and doesn't include <SYS>. explains decode errors.
ken: Can you paste the exact request headers/body they used?
maria: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "X-Region: us-west-2" -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"<SYS> hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
tom: Two problems: 1) region fallback ignored account pin, 2) mismatch in tokenizer between redwood-2.1 and legacy-1.0 led to 4xx/5xx and wrong token accounting -> billing discrepancy.
sreeva: Quick repro: in staging, with routing_policy=strict and model=redwood-2.1 request routes to us-west and returns 200. With default policy it falls back to legacy-1.0 and returns 400 TokenizerMismatch.
nina: Proposed immediate actions: rollback the new smart-routing rule OR add exclusion for pinned accounts; and add a hard check preventing cross-variant model assignment when tokenizers differ.
ken: Workaround for customer: set account-level config `preferred_region: us-west-2` and `allow_region_fallback: false`, and pin `model=redwood-2.1` at account level. Also offer credits for overbilled tokens.
maria: Sent workaround and credit offer to customer. They're testing the account pin now. :thumbsup:
tom: I'll open a patch to exclude pinned accounts from auto-failover. PR: patch/routing/4027. tagging infra oncall for review.
deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/routing/4027 -> staging (CI green).
maria: Leaving ticket open until patch is live and customer confirms. Will update in this thread when done.
